outcome: Neurodevelopmental disorders (ADHD, ASD, intellectual disability, tic disorders, communication disorders, learning disorders)
Psychiatric disorders (anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorder, depressive disorders, eating disorders, bipolar disorders, psychotic disorders)
cohort: 1,179,341 term-birth singletons born in Sweden between January 1, 1990, and December 31, 2003
finding: The association between cesarean delivery and increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in children was likely explained by unmeasured familial confounding.
mod_finding: Compared with vaginal delivery, both planned and intrapartum cesarean delivery were associated with higher risk of any neurodevelopmental disorder, ADHD, and intellectual disability, while only planned cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of ASD, communication disorders, and learning disorders.
